definitions.explanation: A leafy green vegetable commonly used in salads, stir-fries, and other dishes.

examples.japanese: キャベツ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{千切|せんぎ}り→千切り：07473_sengiri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦とんかつ→とんかつ：28094_tonkatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧キャベツ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}いている→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
キャベツ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{豚肉|ぶたにく}→豚肉：02956_butaniku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{炒|いた}める→炒める：01879_itameru⟧。

notes:
キャベツ comes from English "cabbage" and is one of the most widely used vegetables in Japanese cooking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦とんかつ→とんかつ：28094_tonkatsu⟧/⟦コロッケ→コロッケ：10857_korokke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{付|つ}け{合|あ}わせ→付け合わせ：08257_tsukeawase⟧: shredded raw cabbage served with fried foods
- ⟦{野菜|やさい}{炒|いた}め→野菜炒め：14803_yasaiitame⟧: stir-fried vegetables
- ⟦{餃子|ぎょうざ}→餃子：08634_gyouza⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{具|ぐ}→具：07857_gu⟧: gyoza filling
- ⟦ロールキャベツ→ロールキャベツ：noentry⟧: stuffed cabbage rolls
- ⟦お{好|この}み{焼|や}き→お好み焼き：10252_okonomiyaki⟧: a key ingredient in okonomiyaki

TYPES:
- ⟦{春|はる}キャベツ→春キャベツ：28805_harukyabetsu⟧: spring cabbage (softer, sweeter leaves)
- ⟦{紫|むらさき}キャベツ→紫キャベツ：noentry⟧: red/purple cabbage

CULTURAL NOTE:
Shredded raw cabbage (⟦{千切|せんぎ}りキャベツ→千切り：07473_sengiri⟧キャベツ) is the standard accompaniment for tonkatsu and other fried dishes at restaurants across Japan.
